title: Days, months and time words
examples: Teacher, what day comes after Monday?
Can you show me what day is today?
If today is Wednesday, what day was before?

explain.say: There are seven days in a week. Say them with me. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
The days always go in the same order. After Monday comes Tuesday. After Tuesday comes Wednesday.
Today is the day it is now. Yesterday was the day before. Tomorrow is the day after.
If today is Thursday, tomorrow is Friday. Yesterday was Wednesday.
After Sunday, a new week starts with Monday.
A year has twelve months. January is the first month. December is the last month.

faq.q: How many days are in a week?
faq.a: There are seven days in one week. They are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
asks: What is the length of a week?

faq.a: Sunday comes after Saturday. After Sunday, a new week starts with Monday.
asks: What is the next day after Saturday?
After Saturday, what day is it?

faq.q: What does 'before' mean when talking about days?
faq.a: Before means the day just ahead of the day you are talking about. Tuesday comes before Wednesday.

faq.q: If today is Monday, what is tomorrow?
faq.a: If today is Monday, then tomorrow will be Tuesday. Tomorrow is always the next day in the sequence.

faq.q: Do we always start counting days from Sunday?
faq.a: In Ireland and most of Europe, the week starts on Monday. Some calendars start on Sunday. The order of the days stays the same.
asks: Does the week start on Sunday?

facts: There are seven days in one week.
The days of the week are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
Tomorrow is the day that comes after today.
Yesterday is the day that came before today.
There are twelve months in a year, from January to December.

quiz.say: Today is Wednesday. Tap the day before.

wrong.0: Monday is two days before Wednesday.

quiz.say: Today is Friday. Tap the day for tomorrow.
quiz.why: Tomorrow is the next day. Saturday comes after Friday.

wrong.0: Thursday was yesterday, the day before Friday.
wrong.1: Sunday comes two days after Friday.

quiz.say: Say the days in order. Tap the day after Sunday.
quiz.why: After Sunday, a new week starts. The first day is Monday.

wrong.2: Tuesday comes two days after Sunday.
